title: 付款證明上傳 — S3 presigned URL (後端)

findings: S3 client singleton created: src/lib/aws.ts exports s3Client, s3PublicBucket, s3PrivateBucket
Amplify IAM service role handles credentials — no hardcoded access keys needed
APP_AWS_REGION=ap-east-1, APP_S3_PUBLIC_BUCKET and APP_S3_PRIVATE_BUCKET configured in .env/.env.example
Amplify build spec (amplify.yml) injects env vars for SSR runtime
Health check API (GET /api/health) confirms DB + env connectivity after deploy
evidence.residual: API routes (POST /api/upload/presigned-url, POST /api/upload/confirm) not yet implemented. S3 client exists in src/lib/aws.ts (not src/lib/s3.ts — path differs from original spec). S3 buckets must be created in AWS console.

acceptance: Generate S3 presigned PUT URL with 5-minute expiry via @aws-sdk/client-s3
Validate fileType is image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, or application/pdf — reject others
Validate file size < 10MB (check via Content-Length header expectation)
Update Registrant.paymentProofUrl in DB to the S3 key
Auth check: only the registrant's user or admin can upload
files: src/lib/aws.ts (existing — S3 client singleton, replaces planned src/lib/s3.ts)
verification: POST /api/upload/presigned-url with valid fileType → returns uploadUrl. Upload file to that URL via curl → 200. POST /api/upload/confirm → DB updated with paymentProofUrl. Invalid fileType → 400.
